slides.title: *6 sleep rules for people who work late.
Same *wake time.
slides.body: Every day, weekends too. It anchors your body clock more than bedtime does.

slides.title: *Caffeine cutoff.
slides.body: Stop by early afternoon. Caffeine taken six hours before bed still cuts into sleep.

slides.title: *Dim the lights.
slides.body: Lower them in the last hour. Bright light at night tells your brain it's still day.

slides.title: Write a *shutdown list.
slides.body: Put tomorrow's tasks on paper before you stop. It gets them out of your head.

slides.title: Cool, *dark room.
slides.body: Cooler and darker than you think you need.

slides.title: No work in *bed.
slides.body: Bed is for sleep. Keep the laptop out of it.

slides.title: Sleep is *maintenance.
slides.body: Follow @operatorhabits for one habit a day.
